name_reason: Convention-compliant fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: domain=render, descriptor=full_char_stat_panel. Accurately describes the function: it paints the COMPLETE character stat detail panel (HP/MP bars, numeric stats, name/archetype/job text labels, team/status icons) for runtime_char[char_idx], distinct from the smaller fd2_render_mini_char_status_panel. No address residue.
purpose: Paint the full character stat detail panel (HP/MP bars + numeric stats + name/archetype/job text labels + team/status icons) for runtime_char[char_idx] into overlay_buffer, a 0x140-stride pixel surface.
logic_summary: rc = &data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr[char_idx]. Sign-extends HP/MP cur/max words. Draws HP bar (sprite base 0x17) @+0x2A06 and MP bar (0x1A) @+0x41C6 via fd2_render_hp_or_mp_bar_proportional. Draws HP cur/max @+0x344B/+0x3465 and MP cur/max @+0x4ACB/+0x4AE5 via fd2_render_number_red_when_full (red glow when cur==max). Draws white 2-digit level/movement/magic-resist @+0x29DD/+0x379D/+0x455D (status_flags_block[0], movement_order, combat_aux_block[0x14]). Draws AP @+0x545D (red 0x77 if status_flags_block[1] boost flag else white 0x2A), DP @+0x635D (status_flags_block[2]), DX base @+0x4535 (word at ai_target_and_dx_block[1], always white), DX current @+0x5435 and evade @+0x6335 (both share one color flag status_flags_block[3]) -- all via fd2_render_decimal_number_to_buffer. Draws name/archetype/job text labels @+0x10A3/+0x1113/+0x113B via fd2_display_dialog_scene (page = char_id+1 / archetype_flag+0x8C / job_id+0x96). Draws team-flag icon @+0x25E5 (sprite 0x36 if team==0 enemy, else 0x35). Then loops i=0..2 over a raw byte cursor at struct offset +0x25 (an intentional vendor overrun across status_flags_block[4], status_sleep_flag, combat_aux_block[0]); for each non-zero byte blits status-icon sprite 0x37+i @+0x55C2+i*0x23.

params.name: char_idx
params.semantics: Index into data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr (the runtime_char array). Both callers pass a character/cursor index: fd2_render_status_screen_static_layout forwards its own char_idx; fd2_render_recruitment_select_screen passes cursor_idx+1.
params.reason: Accurately reflects use as a runtime_char array index; no address residue; matches protos.h declaration.

params.name: overlay_buffer
params.semantics: Base linear address of the destination pixel surface (0x140-stride). All blit offsets (+0x2A06, +0x10A3, +0x55C2, etc.) are added to it. Callers pass the status-screen overlay buffer or the recruitment-screen composed target buffer.
params.reason: Accurately reflects use as the destination surface base; no address residue; matches protos.h declaration.

returns.semantics: No return value; all output is the rendered panel written into overlay_buffer.
